name: Sunrise Orchard
description: Sunrise Orchard is a small farm in 218 Mt. Tabor Rd, VA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
